title: Authentication Firebase maybe to replace
description: Evaluate whether Firebase auth should be replaced and document rationale.
notes: Decision: keep Firebase Authentication for launch. Rationale: current client/server wiring is complete and recently restored after the vanilla rewrite; public /api/config supplies Firebase SDK config, client auth injects Firebase ID tokens into dashboard API calls, server middleware verifies Firebase Bearer tokens for billing/export/protected routes, and Firestore-backed billing/quota code already depends on the same Firebase Admin setup. Replacing auth before launch would touch sign-in UI, token verification, billing identity, session ownership, claim/export flows, and payment routes without a concrete launch blocker. Revisit only after launch if requirements demand non-Firebase identity, lower vendor coupling, or self-hosted auth.
close_reason: Completed: evaluated Firebase auth replacement and decided to keep Firebase for launch. Verified current auth stack with history review, source inspection, auth-adjacent tests (15 pass), production build, and live server smoke: /api/config returns SDK config while /api/subscription-status and /api/credits return 401 without Firebase credentials.
